@@ -398,24 +398,24 @@ The layout of `acliciprio[k]` for XLEN = 32 is as follows:

 ;; [31:24]
-(draw-box "24" {:span 1 :text-anchor "start" :borders {}})

+(draw-box "24" {:span 1 :text-anchor "end"   :borders {}})
 
 ;; [23:16]

+(draw-box "23" {:span 1 :text-anchor "start" :borders {}})
 (draw-box nil  {:span 6 :borders {}})
-(draw-box "23" {:span 1 :text-anchor "end"   :borders {}})
+(draw-box "16" {:span 1 :text-anchor "end"   :borders {}})
 
 ;; [15:8]
-(draw-box "8"  {:span 1 :text-anchor "start" :borders {}})
+(draw-box "15"  {:span 1 :text-anchor "start" :borders {}})
 (draw-box nil  {:span 6 :borders {}})
-(draw-box "15" {:span 1 :text-anchor "end"   :borders {}})
+(draw-box "8" {:span 1 :text-anchor "end"   :borders {}})
 
 ;; [7:0]
-(draw-box "0"  {:span 1 :text-anchor "start" :borders {}})
+(draw-box "7"  {:span 1 :text-anchor "start" :borders {}})
 (draw-box nil  {:span 6 :borders {}})
-(draw-box "7"  {:span 1 :text-anchor "end"   :borders {}})
+(draw-box "0"  {:span 1 :text-anchor "end"   :borders {}})
 
 ;; ==============================================================
 ;; Data row (MSB→LSB)
